explanation: Silent at GO and D2. At D1 its magnitude is set almost entirely by the previous trial being a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded, gated by episode position: weak before ~trial 72, strongest around trials 82-94, falling off in the last few trials. Other previous-trial patterns (incl. a2 S2 u) give ~0. Free fit adds that within these trials activation is larger when the observer believes S2 is good (negative belief_lo) and when the trial before was also unrewarded, plus a small gain (dev 0.61 vs 0.59). Residual misses are mostly window-first trials whose previous trial is unobserved in the window.

(phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S1 u') * np.maximum(0, 14 - np.abs(ep_trial - 88))

issues: Claims check out. At GO and D2 the residual is exactly 0. At D1, only the previous trial a2 S1 u has a positive residual (+0.099); every other previous-trial pattern sits around -0.01.

The two overlapping windows in the short form are a fitted step approximation of a smooth curve. Fitting one weight per ep_trial bin for D1 after a2 S1 u gives weights 0.05 (70-75), 0.22 (76-79), 0.39 (80-83), 0.59 (84-87), 0.64 (88-91), 0.46 (92-94), 0.17 (95-97) and 0.00 (98+). That bin fit scores test 0.626, so a single triangular ramp centred near trial 88 says the same thing more simply. One such term, (phase == D1) * last_is('a2 S1 u') * np.maximum(0, 14 - np.abs(ep_trial - 88)), scores test 0.631, versus 0.607 for the recorded two-window form.

The free fit's extra claims (larger when belief_lo is negative, when the trial before was also unrewarded, or when the choice two trials back was a2) add almost nothing on test. As third terms they add 0.000-0.002, and the whole 6-term free fit scores 0.633. The explanation should not stress them.

About 37% of the variance stays unexplained even at the pattern x episode-trial ceiling. Inside the window, after a2 S1 u, the feature either fires (~0.8) or stays at 0. No observed variable predicts which: belief (<0.5, <0.2), belief_cover, the action, state or reward two trials back, and stay/action (future) were all tried. Hidden variables (good, since_rev) and next_action do not predict it either.

Misses on the short form show no systematic error class. Mean error by phase is within 0.005, and by phase x previous trial within 0.009. The worst windows are scattered cases where a2 S1 u in the window did not fire, plus D1s on a window's first trial.
